item.base_system: NbMoTaWVTi bulk alloy consolidated by SPS
item.processing: AG-100kNX universal testing machine, strain rate of 1 × 10 −3 s −1
item.test_conditions: Room temperature, cylindrical samples of Φ3 mm × 6 mm
item.property_change: Compressive yield strength of 2709 MPa, fracture strength of 3115 MPa, and total fracture strain of 11.4%
item.attributed_mechanism: Solid solution strengthening, grain boundary strengthening, and precipitation strengthening owing to TiO particles
quotes: The compressive yield strength, fracture strength, and total fracture strain of the consolidated bulk HEA are 2709 MPa, 3115 MPa, and 11.4%, respectively.
The alloy exhibits compressive yield strength of 2709 MPa, fracture strength of 3115 MPa, and total fracture strain of 11.4% at ambient temperature.

The excellent mechanical properties can be attributed to solid solution strengthening and grain boundary strengthening of the fine-grained BCC matrix, as well as the precipitation strengthening owing to the formation of TiO particles.
